_operation: Calendar notification channel push (an ordinary resource change)
_why: P5-005 requires recorded wire fixtures, and the research record lists 'a Calendar sync-message fixture' as NOT WRITTEN. This is NOT a recorded notification. It reproduces the `X-Goog-*` header set the Calendar push guide publishes for a CHANGE message, at the documented zero-length body.
_the_point_of_this_fixture: A CALENDAR NOTIFICATION HAS NO BODY. The guide's example shows `Content-Length: 0` and every value in `X-Goog-*` HEADERS, which is the opposite of the Gmail Pub/Sub envelope (a JSON body whose payload is base64). Two consequences this fixture pins: the parser must read headers only, so a body of any content cannot change the result; and the message cannot be MAC-verified, because there is nothing to sign -- which is why ADR-0099 had to add an authenticator that does not cover the body.
_header_casing: The keys here use the guide's `X-Goog-*` spelling, which is NOT lowercase. The parser looks headers up case-insensitively, so this fixture also proves the lookup does not depend on the fixture's casing.
_the_token_is_redacted: X-Goog-Channel-Token is the anti-spoofing control, so the value used here is the guide's own non-secret example and the parser must never print it (ADR-0091). The unit test asserts the Debug rendering omits it.
_sanitized: No real channel id, resource id, address, or calendar id appears here; the values are the guide's own examples.
